join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!testing_access_level
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Everyone


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!owner
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !owner list|add|remove ...

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!owner what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !owner list|add|remove ...

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!owner list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] There are no owners.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!owner add random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random added to owners.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!owner add @AbCdEf
send hortbot #foobar [HB] abcdef added to owners.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!owner add random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random is already in owners.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!testing_access_level
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Broadcaster

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!owner list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] owners: abcdef, random

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!owner remove random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random removed from owners.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!owner remove random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random is not in owners.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!testing_access_level
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Everyone

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!owner add random
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!owner add random
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=moderator :!owner add random
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mod
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !mod list|add|remove ...

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mod what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !mod list|add|remove ...

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mod list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] There are no mods.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mod add random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random added to mods.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mod add random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random is already in mods.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mod add @AbCdEf
send hortbot #foobar [HB] abcdef added to mods.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!testing_access_level
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Moderator

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mod list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] mods: abcdef, random

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mod remove random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random removed from mods.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!mod remove random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random is not in mods.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!testing_access_level
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Everyone

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!mod add random
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!mod add random
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=moderator :!mod add random
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!regular
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !regular list|add|remove ...

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!regular what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !regular list|add|remove ...

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!regular list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] There are no regulars.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!regular add random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random added to regulars.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!regular add random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random is already in regulars.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!regular add @AbCdEf
send hortbot #foobar [HB] abcdef added to regulars.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!testing_access_level
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Subscriber

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!regular list
send hortbot #foobar [HB] regulars: abcdef, random

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!regular remove random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random removed from regulars.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!regular remove random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random is not in regulars.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!testing_access_level
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Everyone

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!regular add random
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!regular add random
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=moderator :!regular add random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random added to regulars.
